title: Effective BOD for hydrogen sulphide prevention
applicability: Climatic condition is defined as the combination of the average temperature for the warmest three months of the year and the average 6-hour high flow BOD for the day. Where diurnal BOD curves have not been made, this BOD may be assumed to be 1.25 times the BOD of flow proportioned 24-hour composite.
notes: The reference for E BOD is from ASCE Manuals and Reports on Engineering Practice No. 60.
Transcriber note: the definition visibly prints "Effective EBOD"; it has not been silently changed to "Effective BOD".
